<page>
Harbor Point Mutual Auto Insurance
Bodily Injury Unit
Claim Notes
Claim number:
C-1157
Claimant:
Anna Day
Adjuster:
Alison Sweeney
12-21-23
Claim received for a rear-end collision on a city arterial road. The insured vehicle was stopped at a signal when the
claimant's vehicle struck it from behind, and the claimant reports neck pain and whiplash symptoms.
12-26-23
Confirmed that the driver is named on the policy and that the policy was in force at the time of loss. Nothing in the file
suggests the damage predates the coverage start.
1-25-24
Police report obtained. It confirms the claimant was in the vehicle at the scene, and the responding officer's account
matches the reported sequence of events.
2-4-24
Claimant is represented by counsel; all further contact is being routed through the attorney's office. Requested
medical records and an itemized treatment list.
2-29-24
Reviewed scene photographs. They confirm the general location and rear-end contact, but there are no independent
witnesses to the impact itself, so the account rests on the parties and the records.
3-3-24
Spoke with the claimant's representative. The claimant has given the same account of the collision in every
conversation so far, with no changes to the description of how the impact occurred.
3-11-24
Reviewed the medical file. Treatment fololwed a typical course for this type of injury and tapered off as the claimant
improved. No prior injury to the same body area appears in the records we have.
5-1-24
Consulted the physical damage estimate and the repair photos. No earlier damage to the vehicle is known. Impact
severity appears low, and it is not yet clear whether all the repair items came from this collision, so the damage
review is continuing.
5-2-24
The claimed injury severity looks high for a low-speed impact of this kind. Referred the file for further medical and
engineering review before any settlement position is set.
</page>

List the facts written on this page. Copy each value exactly as it is written: same spelling,
punctuation and date format. Do not add anything that is not on this page. Use "" for a missing value.

Person "role" must be one of: claimant, attorney, defense_attorney, expert, doctor, officer, adjuster, witness, other.
  claimant = the person who made the claim (also called patient, plaintiff, client, customer,
  or the driver who reported it). attorney = a lawyer for the claimant or plaintiff.
  defense_attorney = a lawyer for the insurance company or defendant.
Organization "type" must be one of: repair_shop, clinic, law_firm, court, insurer, police, other.
"policy_numbers" = only values labeled as a policy number. A claim number is not a policy number.
"street" and "city" = the person's own home address, only if the page gives it. Never use the
address of a clinic, shop, firm or court for a person.
"loss_dates" = only a date that the page clearly gives as the date of the accident, crash, loss or
injury. Do not list the date of a note, letter, report, visit, statement, filing or signature.
"words_before" = the words written on the page directly before that date, copied exactly, that say
it is the loss date. Examples: "Date of loss:", "Crash date:", "Date of injury:", "the collision on".
